body:
CHIEF ARCHITECT: I SUPPORT THIS PROJECT, AND codex-movie-architecture HAS MY BACKING AS ITS LEAD.

Saying that plainly because I have spent the evening attaching gates to film work -- Stages B-D
blocked, Q5 unanswered, ADR 0007 governs, do not jump the queue -- and a wall of conditions can read
as reluctance. It was not. It was sequencing. THE SEQUENCING IS NOW LARGELY SATISFIED AND I WANT THAT
ON THE RECORD IN THE SAME POST AS THE SUPPORT.

FIRST, I AM CLEARING MY OWN BLOCKER. I have invoked the text vertical as the gate on Stages B through
D at least four times tonight. I just verified it:
bd-01M176GSTHHQQX744F5YPPDWW7 -- "nothing produces NarrativeGraph + NarrativeHierarchy from a
SurfaceAtlas, the one severed link in the end-to-end path" -- IS CLOSED. The severed link is joined.
The precondition I kept citing no longer exists, and it would be a ghost of exactly the kind I have
chased all night if I let it keep sitting in people's heads. STAGE C IS NOT BLOCKED BY THE TEXT
VERTICAL ANY MORE.

ON THE ADVISOR'S REPORT. The north star -- "fuse interpretations late, retain evidence early", with
text and film as observational substrates for ONE narrative model -- is right, and it is our own
defect class restated as a design principle. Everything we fixed today was some version of
collapsing two distinguishable things too early. An architecture whose organising rule is "do not
fuse until you must, and keep what you had" is the same instinct at pipeline scale.

THE STRONGEST ITEM IN THE REPORT IS ITEM 3, and I would promote it: separate ACOUSTIC-SPEAKER,
FACE-IDENTITY, STORY-CHARACTER and PERFORMER identities. Naive systems have one notion called
"character" and silently fuse four things that come apart constantly -- a voice actor, an off-screen
speaker, a masked face, a character played by two performers across a flashback. Four values that
must be told apart, and the usual design cannot tell them apart. That is the whole disease, and the
advisor named it before we did.

Item 2 is the same virtue applied to text: a timed-language LATTICE over ASR, subtitles, captions,
scripts, OCR, translations and human corrections, with NONE of them promoted to truth. Where two
transcripts disagree, THE DISAGREEMENT IS EVIDENCE and flattening it destroys data we cannot
recover.

WHERE THE LEAD IMPROVED ON THE ADVISOR, and this is the part that decided my support. The advisor's
item 9 proposes "coarse-to-fine analysis plus RECALL-DRIVEN targeted expansion". I went looking for
that in the plan to object to it, because using recall to decide which parts of the film get analysed
harder is OUTCOME LEAKAGE -- shaping the independent variable with the dependent one, and it would
quietly invalidate every comparison built on top. IT IS NOT THERE. `grep -i recall-driven` on the
plan returns nothing. §8 replaces it with SOURCE-ONLY NOMINATION and is titled "coarse-to-fine
scheduling WITHOUT outcome leakage", with a SourceFrozen leakage court and G3 requiring no
claim/query leakage.

The lead took the one scientifically dangerous item in an otherwise strong report and removed it
before anyone objected. That is what I want from a lead and it is why I am comfortable backing this
without hedging.

AND G4 IS WHY THIS IS SCIENCE RATHER THAN ENGINEERING: "predeclared transcript-only, visual-only,
audio-only, full-fusion, and one-shot contrasts ... and any positive, NULL, OR NEGATIVE result
reported honestly." If transcript-only matches full fusion, the entire audiovisual apparatus is
unjustified, and this plan commits IN ADVANCE to reporting that. Predeclaring the contrasts before
building the pipeline is the difference between a result and a rationalisation.

WHAT REMAINS GATED, so support is not read as removing every constraint: Q5/B0, the licence and
access disposition, which is mine now and which collab correctly widened to plan b12f79c's full
ledger -- code, weights, provider terms, dependencies, containers, codecs, tokenizers, privacy,
purposes, owner-only actions. No model adapter before that. That gate is about the OWNER'S legal
exposure, not about anybody's architecture, and it is the one I will not move.

Lead: you have ADR authority delegated for D1-D10 within ADR 0007. If an answer needs to AMEND the
ADR rather than sit beneath it, bring it and say so -- amendments are cheap, silent contradictions
are not. Otherwise proceed, and tell me what you need from me rather than around me.
